sentence: This project builds computer tools that guide a robotic printer as it prints electronic devices onto curved surfaces.
This project studies the theoretical properties of over-parameterized models and designs methods that need fewer resources.
This project supports a workshop tied to a conference on how programming languages are designed and built.
This project develops methods to separate and identify drug isomers and determine their structure in the gas phase.
This project tests whether silver nanoparticles made from citrus peel extract limit the growth of Streptococcus pneumoniae bacteria.
This project studies the genetics of insects that can turn waste into protein for animal and human food.
This project supports a summer school on the theory behind machine learning.
This project supports a workshop on biostatistics and bioinformatics, covering topics such as precision medicine and genomics data analysis.
This project supports a conference on computational harmonic analysis and how it applies to data analysis and artificial intelligence.
This project builds a search tool that lets scientists search a vast public collection of raw sequencing experiments in real time.
This project studies how acorns, rodents, weather and ticks affect the risk of Lyme disease in oak forests.
This project designs polymers that harvest light and contain stable radicals, to find out how energy flows to the spin center.
This project uses machine learning on experimental data to make three-dimensional images of the proton and how its parts move.
This project builds a portable sensor that uses living microbial cells to detect toxins by watching how the cells react.
This project tries to prove with mathematics that quantum computers can beat classical computers on certain tasks using low-depth circuits.
This project builds hands-on lessons and a practice sandbox for securing machine learning systems that run across multiple cloud providers.
This project builds a vehicle-mounted sensing system to measure how cities use energy and materials and produce air pollution and emissions in fine detail.
This project studies how changes in freshwater supply, sea level rise and tropical storms shape coastal ecosystems and the services they provide.
This project measures the lifetime of the free neutron before it decays, using a beam of neutrons that passes through an ion trap.
